title: One slot per type
description:
Write `public static class Services` that stores at most one value per type, using a static generic class as the storage (one closed type per `T`, no dictionary):

- `Set<T>(T value)`, `T Get<T>()` (throws `InvalidOperationException` when nothing was set for `T`), `bool Has<T>()` and `Clear<T>()`.
- Values for different types never mix: setting a `string` does not affect `object` or `int`.
hints: Inside `Services`, write `static class Slot<T> { public static T? Value; public static bool IsSet; }`: `Slot<int>` and `Slot<string>` are separate classes with their own static fields (lesson 8.05).
Keep a separate `IsSet` flag, because `default` (0 or `null`) can be a real stored value.
